changes.text: The test track now covers the whole game: 25 tasks from the first kilometre to a season payout, each saying what to check
Previous redemption seasons on the Redemption screen and the website: the pot, what you committed, what you were paid and the ENJ price at settlement
Stake ENJ in the Galavant Peloton pool straight from the app: enter an amount, approve it in your Enjin Wallet; an open request shows on the screen with a Withdraw button
Pull down to refresh on Items and on the Market
Sell an exported NFT for ENJ right from the app or the website: set the price on the item, approve the listing in your Enjin Wallet, and it goes up on the chain
ENJ listings show in the market feed with their price
Buy an ENJ listing in the app or on the website: tap Buy, approve it in your Enjin Wallet, and the bike appears in your Items as an NFT ready to import
Cancelling an ENJ listing is approved in your wallet too, and the item comes back once the chain confirms
Rides sync again — every ride had shown OFFLINE since 3 September because duplicate GPS points in one batch broke the upload; the ride screen now says SERVER ERROR when the server answered
Season payouts could not be sent at all (an internal key was longer than its column); caught in the first live settlement and fixed before any real season paid out
An import request that never showed up in your wallet is now visible on the bike, with a Withdraw button so you can ask again
Buying for ENJ checks your wallet balance first, shows the request's state on the listing (waiting, failed and why, bought), and cannot be sent twice
An NFT is priced in ENJ; to sell one for WATTS, import it into the game first
An exported item can be sold the moment the export is done — the two-hour wait after export is gone
Claim NFTs that arrive in your Enjin Wallet — bought on the Enjin marketplace or sent to you — straight into the game from Profile (web) or the Vault (app), by approving the burn in your wallet
Import from your own wallet: bringing an NFT back into the game is now a signing request in your Enjin Wallet; the item lands once the chain confirms, even if you close the screen
Link your X account with one tap (OAuth) instead of typing a handle
One wallet: your linked Enjin Wallet is the only wallet you have with Galavant. Exported bikes and parts are minted straight into it; there is no separate "game wallet" or deposit address any more
Wallet addresses are shown as real Enjin addresses (Matrixchain on the wallet page, Relaychain next to your stake) instead of a raw key
Season payouts are sent to your linked Enjin Wallet, so a linked wallet is required before you can commit WATTS
NFTs are no longer sold on the game market — trade them on the Enjin marketplace from your wallet, or import them first to sell for WATTS
Exporting needs a linked wallet; the last bike in your garage can be exported too
Starter bikes can be bought with ENJ on the website, paid from your own wallet
Bike detail attribute bars render as solid fills
A freshly exported bike no longer disappears from your inventory while it settles
Token images no longer pick up a stale cache suffix
Chain errors on export/import now say what happened and what to do instead of a bare "validation"
Distance counting drops stretches faster than a human pace and never counts the same GPS fix twice
Bike Condition system — well-maintained bikes earn full SAP, worn bikes earn progressively less. Higher Durability stat (helmet parts) keeps your earn rate up longer between repairs
Bike repairs now take real wall-clock time. The bike is locked from activities during the repair, with Boost-Skip (pay extra SAP) or Cancel (refund) options
Sound effect when you earn SAP during a walk
Speedometer's optimal-speed arc tints green → yellow → red based on your bike's condition, so you can see your live earning rate at a glance
Home screen shows a "Bike is repairing" banner with countdown when your equipped bike is mid-repair, so you don't tap into a locked-bike error
Marketplace listing browser now supports infinite scrolling and improved filters
Legendary breed chance from Epic+Legendary parents raised to 15% (was 5%) and from Uncommon+Legendary to 10% (was 5%) — a Legendary parent now properly contributes
"OPNet" mentions removed from network labels, address labels, and welcome copy — the product runs on Bitcoin
Repair errors are now surfaced — tapping Repair when the server rejects (active session, insufficient SAP, already repairing) shows a clear dialog instead of silently failing
Live earning-rate badge no longer shows "FULL RATE" while the bike is actually worn — reflects current durability immediately
Repair slider on slightly-worn bikes (durability 99–100%) no longer rejects every valid target
Notification when energy refills now shows the correct message
New onboarding screen explains exactly when and how Galavant uses your location, including background tracking during active walks and rides
Visible disclosure on the welcome screen so you know upfront how location is used
Permission flow now shows an explicit Allow / Not now choice before the iOS or Android system prompt, with clear context about what is and isn't tracked
Privacy policy updated to accurately describe how location data is collected during sessions and never outside them
